claim_scope: Only publicly attributable speeches, press conferences, press interactions/bytes, public interview appearances and Q&A interviews. Other material may test assertions but is not a source of new claims.
original_media_limitation: For events documented through newspaper quotes, full unedited recordings were not independently authenticated; paraphrases are not verbatim transcripts.
removed_from_prior_release: Earlier 26-item register included website manifesto assertions, online counters, social-media-only claims, generic media narratives and editor-derived propositions. Those are removed from this public-claim review under the new source restriction.

claims.speaker: Abhijeet Dipke
claims.public_statement_paraphrase: Dipke characterised the Chief Justice's remarks as a comparison of jobless young people with cockroaches and linked them to the movement's formation.
claims.assessment: The India Today interview records Dipke's own account. Its existence establishes what he said, not the full wording or context of the original judicial exchange.
claims.outstanding: Full authenticated hearing transcript, any correction and the court's own record.

claims.speaker: Rajeev Chandrasekhar
claims.public_statement_paraphrase: Chandrasekhar described the CJP phenomenon as showing signs of a cross-border influence operation.
claims.assessment: In the Indian Express interview, he expressly said he could not identify who mounted the supposed operation. No original funding, training, instructions or AEI correspondence is provided.
claims.outstanding: Source documents identifying an organisation, transactions, operational instructions or authenticated contacts.

claims.speaker: Saurav Das
claims.public_statement_paraphrase: Das described CJP's immediate plan as building a grassroots pressure movement, rather than joining electoral politics.
claims.assessment: NDTV published his statement on the day of the education minister's resignation. It is evidence of CJP's declared plan at that date, not proof of future conduct.
claims.outstanding: Dated organisational resolutions and any subsequent registration filings.

claims.speaker: Ashutosh Ranka
claims.public_statement_paraphrase: Asked about his own political future, Ranka declined to rule out a later political career.
claims.assessment: NDTV's interview presents Ranka's answer alongside Das's organisational answer. They concern different questions; they do not establish a settled plan to contest elections.
claims.outstanding: Later explicit decision, governance resolution or filing.

claims.speaker: Ashutosh Ranka
claims.public_statement_paraphrase: Ranka said a negotiated agreement would cover withdrawal of FIRs against all protesters and organisers and prevent future FIRs.
claims.assessment: The Supreme Court's 1 September written order contains defined terms, scope and an exception concerning 2,873 persons. The interview did not itself constitute blanket legal immunity.
claims.outstanding: Follow-on FIR registers and implementation of the order.

claims.speaker: Ashutosh Ranka
claims.public_statement_paraphrase: Ranka said Pradhan's resignation had occurred before the CJP delegation arrived at the final government meeting.
claims.assessment: The Presidential communique establishes the resignation. The interview places the delegation's meeting after the decision, but does not prove why the minister resigned.
claims.outstanding: Official decision correspondence and an independently sourced meeting log.

claims.speaker: Abhijeet Dipke
claims.public_statement_paraphrase: Dipke described the movement as a response group working on education, unemployment and institutional trust, and said it would not join a political party.
claims.assessment: The Aaj Tak question-and-answer interview reports these positions. They should not be converted into a perpetual commitment or formal legal status.
claims.outstanding: Subsequent recorded statements and any organisational registration.

claims.speaker: Abhijeet Dipke
claims.public_statement_paraphrase: Dipke denied that any political party created the protest movement and said supporters of multiple parties had attended.
claims.assessment: An interview records a denial of party direction. Documented former party links and public endorsements establish some associations, not who controlled organising or funding.
claims.outstanding: Contemporaneous campaign minutes, independently authenticated instructions and audited resources.

claims.speaker: Abhijeet Dipke
claims.public_statement_paraphrase: Dipke estimated that 70–80% of attendees raised their hands when he asked whether they were first-time protesters.
claims.assessment: A self-reported show of hands is not a representative survey or count of all participants. No sampling method, event-by-event denominator or independent verification accompanies it.
claims.outstanding: Original event footage, attendance sampling and a reproducible estimate.

claims.speaker: Abhijeet Dipke
claims.public_statement_paraphrase: Dipke said ordinary citizens, doctors and professors donated food and refreshments for protesters.
claims.evidence_status: Reported in-kind support; accounts not audited
claims.assessment: The statement identifies a claimed funding channel. It does not prove that all donations are accounted for or that competing funding allegations are true.
claims.outstanding: Published financial accounts, records of in-kind support and independent audits.

claims.speaker: Abhijeet Dipke
claims.public_statement_paraphrase: Dipke argued that the amended examination-leak law focuses on penalties after leaks rather than on prevention.
claims.assessment: The interview documents a criticism of policy design. Whether the law contains sufficient preventive obligations requires clause-by-clause comparison with the enacted text and its rules.
claims.outstanding: Authenticated enacted amendment, rules and original version for a redline.

claims.speaker: Abhijeet Dipke
claims.public_statement_paraphrase: Dipke said he had demanded one crore rupees in compensation for each affected family and that payment had not been received by that interview.
claims.assessment: His statement concerns the position on 31 July. A later Supreme Court order directed a compensation framework within 90 days; this is not proof that money had been paid.
claims.outstanding: Government notifications and beneficiary-level disbursement evidence.

claims.speaker: Abhijeet Dipke
claims.public_statement_paraphrase: Dipke said the movement would remain democratic and peaceful, while defending satire as a form of protest.
claims.assessment: A declared nonviolence principle is distinct from the behaviour of every individual during large demonstrations. Police and protesters dispute parts of the July clashes.
claims.outstanding: Time-stamped footage and case-specific judicial findings for contested incidents.

claims.speaker: Abhijeet Dipke
claims.public_statement_paraphrase: Dipke said the voter-roll revision had deleted about 13 crore names and cited it as the basis of the CJP protest.
claims.assessment: The public remarks used a broad count. Published totals combine distinct administrative categories; they do not by themselves quantify wrongful loss of voting rights by eligible citizens.
claims.outstanding: State-wise starting rolls, final rolls, restoration and appeals, with definitions held constant.

claims.speaker: Abhijeet Dipke
claims.public_statement_paraphrase: Dipke described CJP as having no substantial cadre or resources, relying instead on public support.
claims.assessment: The claim establishes the founder's public presentation of the group, not audited assets or operating funds.
claims.outstanding: Dated membership, expenditure, donation and staffing records.

claims.speaker: Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka
claims.public_statement_paraphrase: Das said CJP was not competing with the Congress or AAP; Ranka said CJP had not reached out to Rahul Gandhi about the protest.
claims.evidence_status: Dated denial; broader ties not excluded
claims.assessment: The Indian Express directly attributes these answers. Not contacting one political leader is narrower than claiming no contacts with any party or activist network.
claims.outstanding: Authentic meeting records and later statements if the relationship changes.

claims.speaker: Abhijeet Dipke
claims.public_statement_paraphrase: Dipke criticised train and Metro restrictions ahead of the protest and compared them with the Emergency period.
claims.evidence_status: Documentable restrictions; historical analogy is opinion
claims.assessment: The reported closures and orders need individual legal examination. Saying they were worse than a historical Emergency is an evaluative analogy, not an adjudicated fact.
claims.outstanding: Original transport orders, policing instructions and relevant court findings.

claims.speaker: Abhijeet Dipke
claims.public_statement_paraphrase: Dipke said CJP was independent of political parties, had not held specific discussions with Rahul Gandhi and shared some concerns with the INDIA bloc.
claims.evidence_status: Attributed account; formal ties not demonstrated
claims.assessment: The Indian Express and Loksatta recorded remarks to reporters. Shared public demands do not prove operational coordination, and a denial does not audit every relationship.
claims.outstanding: Formal alliance decisions, dated contacts and corroborated operational records.

claims.speaker: Abhijeet Dipke
claims.public_statement_paraphrase: Dipke said CJP's roughly 25 million followers were not a vote bank belonging to a political party.
claims.evidence_status: Follower total and preferences not independently verified
claims.assessment: A claimed audience metric does not measure verified membership, turnout or each follower's preferences. The claim should remain attributed to its speaker.
claims.outstanding: Date-stamped platform analytics, denominator definitions and independent survey evidence.

claims.speaker: Abhijeet Dipke
claims.public_statement_paraphrase: Dipke argued that the two leaders were being held merely for raising the Indian flag at Jantar Mantar.
claims.assessment: Reuters reported police reliance on alleged breaches of undertakings and public-order restrictions. A five-day custody order is not a criminal conviction, but the flag alone is not the only reason given by police.
claims.outstanding: Authenticated magistrate order, undertakings, police report and adjudication.

claims.speaker: Abhijeet Dipke
claims.public_statement_paraphrase: Dipke asserted that the Supreme Court had minimised West Bengal voter deletions and helped the Election Commission in party-symbol disputes.
claims.assessment: The interview report notes that no case names were supplied for the party-symbol allegation. A judicial finding cannot be reconstructed safely from a speaker's paraphrase.
claims.outstanding: Case names, hearing transcript and signed orders establishing the actual judicial reasoning.

claims.speaker: Rekha Gupta
claims.public_statement_paraphrase: Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta called CJP an AAP 'B party' and questioned its choice of protest issues.
claims.evidence_status: Political allegation; command chain not shown
claims.assessment: The reported press conference presents Gupta's criticism. Earlier affiliations and parallel priorities do not alone establish formal subordination, funding or instructions.
claims.outstanding: Authenticated decision records, transfers, contracts or direct instructions supporting a current control relationship.
